text:
nina: quick thread: we've got two competing asks from sales and security. Sales wants minimal latency inside tenant VPCs (no extra PrivateLink hops). Security/SRE want a single auditable control plane path. can we reconcile?

omar: short answer: yes, with an outbound-only cache + control invalidation + a tombstone kill-switch. but we must spec exact semantics or ops will hate us.

lee: idea: agent = read-only snapshot + outbound control stream. bootstrap uses PrivateLink once to seed the snapshot and exchange credentials. after bootstrap, all communication is outbound mTLS to our relay, no inbound peering.

nina: latency wins, but how do we ensure revocation windows? customer asks for ~10s for cert revokes. can we meet that?

omar: we can if we have prioritized invalidation messages and synchronous apply for revokes. flow: CP publishes REVOCATION (priority) -> relay fanout -> agent ACKs -> agent marks key revoked and emits immediate audit event. if agent doesn't ACK within X, CP escalates and publishes a tenant tombstone that forces fail-closed.

lee: tombstone is critical. semantics: tombstone = deny-all until a fresh bootstrap occurs. useful for suspected compromise or agent drift. must be global per-tenant and idempotent.

platform-bot: ticket RED-NTW-701 created for inboundless-cache prototype; owners @nina @omar.

nina: audit model options: 1) realtime per-decision stream (expensive), 2) signed per-minute digests, 3) hybrid: high-sensitivity ops realtime, low-sensitivity batched. security prefers (1) for top-tier tenants.

omar: agree hybrid is pragmatic. we also attach monotonic seq numbers to every decision so digests can be verified later. signed digests support post-hoc forensics.

lee: bootstrap flow (sketch):
```
1) tenant provisions PrivateLink + grants bootstrap role
2) operator runs agent in tenant VPC (helm) -> agent calls CP bootstrap endpoint over PrivateLink
3) CP returns snapshot + short-lived agent cert + list of subscribed topics
4) agent opens persistent outbound mTLS stream to CP relay and starts applying updates
```

nina: ops: how do we upgrade agents? helm-managed daemonset, minor auto-update, majors opt-in. also need a simple rollback path if tombstone incorrectly fired.

omar: monitoring: invalidation_latency_ms, last_applied_seq, tombstone_events, bootstrap_failures, cache_hit_ratio, audit_egress_bytes. dashboards mandatory before pilot.

lee: fallback policy pseudocode:
```
if op.sensitivity == HIGH:
  if cache.hit and not stale: return cached
  elif outbound_stream.ok: sync_pull_and_validate; if validated: return
  else: return 403
else:
  if cache.hit: return cached_with_warn
  elif outbound_stream.ok: try_sync
  elif privatelink.available: call_privatelink
  else: return cached_stale_with_warn
```

nina: note: "privatelink.available" should be a config flag set by tenant during bootstrap. default=false to avoid implicit network exposure.

omar: failure modes: if agent loses stream and cannot bootstrap within TTL, CP publishes tombstone. that will surface in autopage and SRE playbook. need clear runbook.

lee: security: BYOK support required for regulated tenants so signing material can stay in-customer KMS. agent must support HSM-backed signing or forward CSR via PrivateLink to CP if BYOK not used.

nina: decision (tentative): implement opt-in outbound-only cache agent with single bootstrap PrivateLink step, prioritized invalidations + tombstone, hybrid audit (realtime for HIGH ops), BYOK support. PrivateLink remains default for tenants that do not opt in.

platform-bot: NOTE: include per-tenant ACLs for pubsub topics and short-lived agent cert rotation (<6h).

lee: next: I'll write sequence diagrams and a minimal protobuf for the control stream (revokes, snapshots, tombstone, heartbeat). who wants to review?

omar: I'll take security and runbook review. nina: can you own pilot selection + legal for BYOK?

nina: yep. pilot = 2 internal tenants + 1 partner. we measure staleness, invalidation latency, and audit egress for 30d.

platform-bot: updated RED-NTW-701 with checklist: proto draft, helm chart, dashboards, runbook.

nina: cool. posting RFC follow-up with diagrams and the sensitivity matrix tomorrow. add anything here if I missed it. :rocket:
